# Vendored sfgl

Copied by `scripts/vendor-sfgl.mjs` from sfgl commit `97da17b46befb43e721354a3f3476ec28add5eba`.
Do not edit these files here; change sfgl and run the script again.

- `src/`, `fonts/host-grotesk/`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE.md`, `licenses/`: as in sfgl (MIT; the font is SIL OFL 1.1).
- `symbols/glyphs/`: only the 99 SF Symbols the web client uses. **These are Apple's artwork, not covered by any license in this repository.** Read `symbols/PROVENANCE.md` before distributing them.
